jobs.title: LLM Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Tailspin Data is a small consultancy that ships AI products for startups across the Americas.</p><p>Ship LLM features for our startup clients, from prototype to production.</p><li>Build RAG pipelines and agents in Python, with evaluation against labeled data.</li><li>Deploy with Docker and FastAPI; our clients run on GCP or Azure.</li><li>4+ years of experience in ML or software engineering; prompt engineering and LLM evaluation.</li><li>LangChain experience is a plus.</li><p>Remote from anywhere in Latin America. Contractor role, paid in USD.</p>

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Tailspin Data is a small consultancy that ships AI products for startups across the Americas.</p><p>Train and deploy image models for retail catalog automation.</p><li>PyTorch, transfer learning and image classification in production.</li><li>Experience serving models behind an API (FastAPI) in Docker.</li><li>Bonus: OCR and document AI.</li><p>Remote from LATAM, paid in USD.</p>

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Tailspin Data is a small consultancy that ships AI products for startups across the Americas.</p><p>Work directly with our clients to turn LLM prototypes into production systems.</p><li>Python, LLMs, retrieval and evaluation; comfortable presenting to non-technical stakeholders.</li><li>Deploy and monitor what you build (Docker, CI/CD, GCP).</li><p>We hire candidates based anywhere in LATAM, as contractors paid in USD.</p>
